injuries: WAS Terry McLaurin (WR): on injured reserve
WAS Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB): Questionable, on IR and expected to be activated before kickoff

notes: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin is on injured reserve and Bengals WR Andrei Iosivas (thumb, IR) is doubtful, so both are left out.

Commanders RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) is questionable and expected to be activated from IR before kickoff after four games out; Rachaad White (heel) is questionable after missing Saturday's practice. Both are simulated as playing, but neither gets a call. If White sits, Austin Ekeler gets more carries.
Joe Burrow (illness) and Jayden Daniels (elbow) practised fully and carry no designation.
